summary: The design has a sound extension point, but its compatibility, persistence, validation, and test scope are incomplete. The highest risks are changing unset Spanish callbacks to English, missing per-user/database migration paths, and allowing request-time or untrusted language values to affect a CONFIGURE-phase prompt.

suggestions.title: Define the unset-language behavior for Python-authored messages
suggestions.rationale: The proposed English phrase-table fallback contradicts backwards compatibility: `JiraSpecialist` currently emits Spanish callback and standup messages, including `Entendido`, while unset language is supposed to preserve today’s behavior. Make `None` explicitly mean legacy output, and reserve English for an explicit `language="en"`; add regression assertions for the no-language case.

suggestions.title: Cover all persistence paths and existing-row migration semantics
suggestions.rationale: `UserBotModel` and `users_bots_creation.sql` independently default language to `"en"`, and the manager constructs user bots through `to_bot_kwargs()`. The design only names `BotModel`; changing model defaults and fresh-table DDL will not convert existing rows. Also, `test_storage_gates.py` currently requires `ai_bots` DDL and `creation.sql` to remain unchanged, so the spec must define a migration/gate update and whether legacy `en` rows become unset or remain explicit English.

suggestions.title: Do not inject raw language input into the system prompt
suggestions.rationale: The UI accepts arbitrary text and the database field has no language validator, while the proposal says unknown values are passed raw into the directive. A value containing XML, newlines, template syntax, or prompt instructions can alter the system prompt. Normalize a bounded BCP-47-like value, use an allowlisted display-name mapping, escape prompt text, and define a safe fallback without logging sensitive configuration.

suggestions.title: Freeze or remove a false CONFIGURE-phase layer
suggestions.rationale: `PromptLayer.partial_render()` returns the original layer unchanged when its condition is false. Because `PromptBuilder.build()` evaluates that condition again against request context and `_build_prompt()` forwards arbitrary kwargs, a later request containing `language` could activate a layer that was absent at configure time, violating static resolution and prompt-cacheability. Drop false CONFIGURE layers or replace them with an irrevocably disabled layer, and test configure-with-None followed by build-with-language.

suggestions.title: Specify built-in factory coverage and custom-builder opt-out
suggestions.rationale: The proposal says every factory, but `PromptBuilder.minimal()` is a separate factory and is exposed through `presets.py`; explicit custom builders are also accepted by `JiraSpecialist` and can omit standard layers. Either centralize installation across all built-in factories, or document that custom/minimal builders opt out and test that contract explicitly.

suggestions.title: Update the omitted grounding tests and documentation
suggestions.rationale: The proposed scope misses `test_jira_grounding_layer.py`, which asserts the English sentinels and English-only content, and `docs/prompts/layers-reference.md`, which documents the layer as unconditional and variable-free. Updating only the two named Jira tests and one Jira document will leave direct contract checks failing or stale.

suggestions.title: Represent localized operational text as protected templates
suggestions.rationale: The callback output contains the Jira status `In Progress`, while the requirements forbid translating statuses and transition names. A phrase table storing whole rendered strings can accidentally localize identifiers. Store prose templates with explicit protected placeholders for ticket keys, status names, usernames, and durations; test that every configured locale preserves those values byte-for-byte.

suggestions.title: Test the rendered prompt and callbacks rather than only constants or fakes
suggestions.rationale: The grounding tests replace `agent.ask` with hand-written fake responses, and the direct grounding-layer tests only inspect a module constant. Callback tests do not cover localized `edit_message` or escalation output. Add matrix tests for unset/en/es/regional language at the builder and `AbstractBot._build_prompt()` levels, plus direct callback/escalation tests; state that these tests verify directive presence, not model compliance.

suggestions.title: Consider keeping FEAT-138 sentinel tokens invariant
suggestions.rationale: The grounding layer and tests deliberately freeze `No results found for` and `Jira lookup failed`, while other code and documentation treat them as stable machine-detectable phrases. A lower-risk variant keeps those exact prefixes invariant and localizes only surrounding prose and standup messages; this preserves the existing contract while still improving artifact language.
